verdict.rationale: The first-party docs say developers can have their own Playwright/Puppeteer code connect directly over CDP to Browser Use cloud browsers (docs-18). They also describe launching a browser and connecting to its CDP URL (docs-2, docs-26), and position Browser Infrastructure as a remote browser for your own agents (docs-27). Missing for 10: detailed code-level docs for each library (Playwright vs Puppeteer specifics), clarity on whether saved auth profiles carry over to CDP-connected sessions, and independent or hands-on corroboration that existing scripts work unmodified.
